//: Commands run from the REPO ROOT (Railway Root Directory must be BLANK, not 'dashboard') so the build sees repo-root /shared/* that the dashboard imports. Standalone mode (next.config.mjs) bundles all server-side files into .next/standalone/ — but next.config.mjs also sets outputFileTracingRoot to the REPO ROOT (one level above dashboard/), so Next.js mirrors dashboard/'s own path inside standalone: the real output is .next/standalone/dashboard/, not .next/standalone/ directly (verified against the actual local build output 2026-08-19). The flat-path version of this file silently broke every dashboard deploy from 2026-08-14 onward with 'cp: cannot create directory .next/standalone/.next/static: No such file or directory', while unrelated agent/backend deploys on the same commits kept succeeding — the two services' deploy health are independent, so a red dashboard build here does not show up as a red anything-else. Static assets (.next/static/) and public/ are NOT traced by standalone and must be copied manually into the standalone tree so next/server serves them. server.js lives at .next/standalone/dashboard/server.js (repo-root-relative: dashboard/.next/standalone/dashboard/server.js).

build.buildCommand: cd dashboard && npm ci && npm run build && cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/dashboard/.next/static && ([ -d public ] && cp -r public .next/standalone/dashboard/public || true)
